stemMd: A ball is thrown horizontally from a cliff. Neglect air resistance. Which statement holds before it lands?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Its horizontal velocity stays constant while its vertical velocity changes.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Its vertical acceleration becomes zero at the highest point.

explanationMd: With no air resistance, the only force is gravity. Thus horizontal acceleration is zero and vertical acceleration is downward with magnitude g. The independent components give constant horizontal velocity and changing vertical velocity.

distractorRationale.d: Gravitational acceleration remains downward throughout flight.
distractorRationale.b: The growing vertical component changes the speed.
